text: Scope reduced per the session-location resolution: kernel keeps the mechanism only. Agreement is now the single shared identity check for clocks and frames, with n-ary forms; Interval.overlaps/encloses, Overlap.selects and Warp.andThen all route through it (they had already diverged into three inlined copies). AgreementSuite asserts the convention. Session moved to eyes4s-design as bead x-session. PRD G-10 rewritten, G-11/G-11a added. 63 kernel + 87 law tests green JVM+JS.
